Step 3. Applying the singular interpolation theorem to \(W_{01360013}\), we obtain the norm bound in the mixed Lebesgue scale for the appropriate exponents.

Conclusion. Steps 1-3 yield the result via asymptotic interpolation and the uniqueness of the decomposition.
